name: Scholarnest
description: In this district, status means scholarly merit rather than wealth or title. Though mostly middle-class, it offers scholarships and free housing to exceptional, less privileged students, making it the most socially diverse area. Lined with white marble buildings and statues of notable figures like Archmage Torygg and Emperor Baleroth, the district buzzes with intellectual fervor. Home to theaters and the Imperial University of Light, Scholarnest is both a bastion of Imperial dogma and a cradle of radical thought, drawing covert agents from various factions. Ideas born here often shape the continent, making control of its discourse a priority for key players, including Emperor Baleroth. Scholars frequently disappear, many presumably detained for subversive ideas. The Ironhand and the Imperial Department of Truth often reward individuals aiding in suppressing misinformation, lies, and socially destabilizing ideologies, employing hidden agents and even mercenaries to uncover disruptive individuals.
